The examination and treatment you have received today has been on an emergency basis only and has not been intended to be a substitute for complete medical care. Since it is impossible to recognize and treat all elements of injury or illness in a single visit, for your protection in preventing possible complications, if you are not clearly improving in the next 12 hours, you should be seen for a re-check at this emergency room or at your own doctor's office immediately.

IF YOU FEEL YOUR CONDITION HAS AGAIN BECOME AN EMERGENCY, RETURN TO THIS DEPARTMENT AT ONCE, DAY OR NIGHT.

IF YOU EXPERIENCE SHORTNESS OF BREATH OR CHEST PAIN, PLEASE CALL 9-1-1.

Medication Instructions:
Continue your current medications as you have been, unless instructed otherwise by your Provider today. If any new medication were prescribed today, take them as directed.

If you have been prescribed medication(s) as part of your care plan, read the medication package insert carefully and completely AND ask your pharmacist for complete information about medication use, side effects, precautions, and interactions with other medications that you currently take.

Make sure to bring any attached imaging reports and lab results to your doctor. As we discussed, these must be reviewed by your doctor to decide what additional testing or treatment may be needed to address any abnormal results.
